hypotheses.statement: commander.js is a mature, zero-dependency CLI framework in maintenance/plateau phase: correctness and compatibility valued above feature velocity; risks are governance (bus factor, typosquat) and legacy-surface drift, not code rot

revise.statement: package is commander v14.0.3, MIT, 'complete solution for node.js command-line programs', CJS with ESM wrapper, Node >=20, zero runtime dependencies

Core architecture: Command extends EventEmitter (parser + tree + lifecycle hooks); Option/Argument data classes with parseArg/choices/conflicts/implies/env/preset; DualOptions for negated pairs; Help class with style hooks; CommanderError taxonomy; process.exit default with exitOverride
Option values flow via EventEmitter events 'option:<name>' with source tracking (default/config/env/cli/implied) enabling layered env/config precedence
Strict-by-default posture, increasing: unknown options error, excess args error (13.0.0), flag-format errors (13.0.0), duplicate option/command registration errors
Test surface: ~109 jest suites + tsd type tests + ESM import test + executable-subcommand fixtures; CI matrix node 20/22/24 x 3 OS; CodeQL; coverage collected without threshold

Active maintainers are John Gee (shadowspawn) and Abe Tomoaki (abetomo); recent history dominated by dependabot churn; last feature work 14.0.0 (2025-05-18); release cadence ~6-month majors, 12-month security window for old majors
Adoption: commander is in the >10M weekly-download tier on npm and among top packages by dependents
evidence: dev.to audit of >10M weekly download packages

revise.statement: No CVEs for commander itself; malicious typosquat 'commmander' exists on npm (MAL-2025-192687, MAL-2025-17423)
Deprecation surface of ~10 legacy features still implemented (RegExp option arg, noHelp, help callbacks, '--help' events, command:'*', _args, addHelpCommand legacy forms)
Manual hand-written typings (1113-line index.d.ts + esm.d.mts) kept in sync via tsd tests, tsc checkJS, and ts-imports tests
